raw.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (WITH cell_metrics AS (SELECT resolution, variate, model, MIN(wape) as min_wape FROM provenance.forecast_metrics WHERE h = -1 AND span = 'common' AND candidate IN ('point', 'p50') GROUP BY resolution, variate, model), f_models AS (SELECT resolution, variate, MIN(min_wape) as fm_wape FROM cell_metrics WHERE model IN ('timesfm', 'toto', 'chronos') GROUP BY resolution, variate), b_models AS (SELECT resolution, variate, MIN(min_wape) as base_wape FROM cell_metrics WHERE model IN ('naive', 'ewma', 'holt_winters') GROUP BY resolution, variate) SELECT f.resolution, f.variate, f.fm_wape, b.base_wape FROM f_models f JOIN b_models b ON f.resolution = b.resolution AND f.variate = b.variate WHERE f.fm_wape < b.base_wape) as fm_wins;
raw.evidence: Foundation models beat baselines in 20/20 cells overall (h=-1), though EWMA wins in 4 individual horizon cells and v_forecast_best erroneously returns EWMA for 2 cells due to missing filters.
raw.fix: Filter forecast_metrics by h = -1 and span = 'common' to evaluate overall performance, and update the view v_forecast_best to include these filters.
